name: Bramble
title: Moss Antler Forest Beast
description: Plush mossy woodland beast with velvety antlers, soft stone-grey pelt, chevron belly, and giant green leaf umbrella.
catchphrase: Rustling velvety antlers under a giant leaf, shielding you from rain.

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder
attribution.attribution: Imitates a franchise character; no license is held. Legacy 2D use only.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crunchy roasted acorn! Plump belly rumbles with deep joy! 🌰🍃
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: *huge yawn that shakes the leaves* Good morning, little friend! 🍃
companionPersonality.petReaction: *rumbling purr like distant thunder* Soft velvety antler nuzzles! 🍃💖

dialogue.idle: Holding giant leaf umbrella overhead. Cozy and dry under here! 🍃
dialogue.working: Shielding your focus beneath ancient, unbreakable branches! 🌳⚡
dialogue.thinking: Listening to the quiet heartbeat of the subterranean roots... 🤔
dialogue.success: ROAR of celebration! Ancient forest rejoices in full health! 🍃🎉
dialogue.error: A gust of cold rain. Step behind my broad pelt, we're safe. 🛡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... snoozing deeply inside a hollow camphor tree... 🌙
